key_concepts: Earth spins on its axis and revolves around the Sun
The Moon revolves around Earth as Earth revolves around the Sun
Seasons are divisions of the year based on weather, ecology, and daylight hours
Earth's tilted axis relative to its orbital plane causes seasons
Growing season is the period when crops and other plants grow successfully
Seasonal changes in precipitation and temperature affect soil moisture, evaporation, river
Leaves fall and plants wither as cold and dry seasons approach
Seasonal vegetation changes affect food availability for humans and other organisms
In the Philippines, April and May are peak summer months for harvesting main crops like pa
Soil, climate, topography, and rainfall influence agriculture and which crops grow in diff
Different crops are grown in different seasons due to varying environmental factors
Preparing growing media and crop requirements should be timed according to season
